answer: The strongest lever is simple: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because glacier only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, timber is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any lotus approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
